observation: The parent Workflow again hit its registered 120-second execution ceiling after common Workflow-task concurrency was raised to 128. All 32 Child Workflows started, but their captured histories contain 697 scheduled recovery Activities, with as many as 36 for one child, before the exact 32-item backlog barrier completed.
inference: Local Workflow-task capacity is not a sufficient cohort barrier. An early child can durably re-enter its one-millisecond unsafe recovery loop before every unique child has recorded the initial outage result, so the exact backlog phase can starve under the full accumulated sentinel sequence.
correction: Add a common durable recovery-cohort gate after an initial outage result. Each item must wait on the gate without occupying the frozen Work Activity slots; the last unique initial item releases the gate. The accepted rerun must use a new append-only root.
